metadata.overall_arc: Comfort → Engagement → Anxiety → Pressure → Overwhelm → Resignation

ai_reasoning.explanation: This is a classic onboarding screen designed to be inviting and non-threatening, using positive language and soft visuals to encourage the user to begin the experience.

emotions.name: Comfort
emotions.description: Warm, pink-toned gradient, gentle 'breathing' animation on button, welcoming text, flower emoji

emotions.name: Anticipation
emotions.description: Promise of 'something wonderful', glowing start button, familiar 'Instagram' branding

strategy.description: Onboard the user, establish a positive and familiar tone, provide a clear CTA
Potential Participant
Read the welcome message, click the start button
Start the experience → Warm Notifications, Close window → Exit
Calm, inviting, zero stakes, warm aesthetic

ai_reasoning.explanation: This state establishes a positive reinforcement loop using classic gamification to build user investment. The disabled escape button subtly introduces the theme of losing control.

emotions.name: Delight
emotions.description: Positive feedback notifications, heart emoji bursts on click, warm color palette

emotions.name: Engagement
emotions.description: Constant stream of notifications, satisfying click interactions, rising counter

emotions.name: Comfort
emotions.description: Gentle slide-in animations, soft visual style, non-threatening content

strategy.description: Create a positive feedback loop, build user investment, establish a baseline
Valued User, Recipient of Praise
Tap notifications, watch the counter increase, feel popular
Tap notifications → reward, Click disabled escape button → no effect
Positive, rewarding, low stakes, warm purple/pink aesthetic

ai_reasoning.explanation: The experience pivots from pure positive reinforcement to a mix of positive and negative feedback, creating performance anxiety. The degrading visual cues reinforce this emotional shift.

emotions.name: Anxiety
emotions.description: Negative notifications, muted/cool color palette, slow background color shift

emotions.name: Unease
emotions.description: Glitching app title, eyeball burst animations on click, darkening screen vignette

emotions.name: Tension
emotions.description: Enabled but ineffective escape button, introduction of punishment notifications

strategy.description: Introduce negative feedback, shift emotional tone, create performance anxiety
Performer, Scrutinized User
Keep tapping, try to escape, notice the negative shift
Continue tapping → mixed results, Attempt escape → ineffective
Tense, cool-toned, rising stakes, subtle visual degradation

ai_reasoning.explanation: This phase simulates addictive social media mechanics, using variable rewards (mystery boxes) and loss aversion (timers, guilt) to compel frantic interaction.

emotions.name: Urgency
emotions.description: Notifications with countdown timers, FOMO-inducing content, faster notification speed

emotions.name: Pressure
emotions.description: Guilt-tripping messages, punishment for slow responses, constant demands

emotions.name: Addiction
emotions.description: Mystery boxes and jackpots creating a variable reward loop, chasing streaks

strategy.description: Employ dark patterns, variable reinforcement, and time pressure to maximize stress
Addict, Gambler
Tap faster, respond to urgent prompts, chase rewards, avoid punishments
Engage with high-risk notifications, try to escape
High pressure, chaotic, urgent, mix of red/gold/purple visuals

ai_reasoning.explanation: This is the climax of the negative arc, representing total loss of agency. The experience breaks its own rules (notifications leaving the phone) to show the user they are completely trapped.

emotions.name: Overwhelm
emotions.description: Extremely fast notification storm, chaotic shaking animations, sensory overload

emotions.name: Dread
emotions.description: Ominous messages, demonic/skull icons, dark red and black color scheme

emotions.name: Powerlessness
emotions.description: Escape button becomes a taunt, notifications escaping the phone frame, loss of control

strategy.description: Induce sensory overload, break the fourth wall, demonstrate inescapability
Trapped Soul, Helpless Observer
Witness the chaos, attempt futile escape, endure the onslaught
Click notifications → more chaos, Click escape → punishment
Apocalyptic, chaotic, inescapable, hellish red/black visuals

ai_reasoning.explanation: This is a 'velvet rope' strategy. It makes the user feel successful and frames the choice to continue not as a risk, but as the obvious next step for a high-achiever.

emotions.name: Empowerment
emotions.description: Positive framing, flattering stats, feeling of success and popularity

emotions.name: Temptation
emotions.description: Encouraging language, promise of 'something bigger', large, glowing 'Yes' button

strategy.description: Gate progression with a choice, use flattery and FOMO to encourage continuation
Decision-Maker, Star Performer
Read the praise, feel special, click the big 'Yes' button
Continue → Stress Phase, Stop → Trap Screen
Pause in action, celebratory, low-pressure decision point

ai_reasoning.explanation: The strategy shifts from simple flattery to creating a sense of social responsibility, a more powerful and manipulative motivator for the user to continue.

emotions.name: Validation
emotions.description: Escalated praise, impressive-sounding stats like 'Trending in 3 cities'

emotions.name: Obligation
emotions.description: Manipulative language ('they need you!'), creating social pressure to continue

strategy.description: Increase manipulative praise, introduce social obligation, reinforce sunk cost
Influencer, Valued Commodity
Internalize the praise, feel the social pressure, continue the journey
Continue → Intense Phase, Stop → Trap Screen
Pause in action, high praise, increased social stakes

ai_reasoning.explanation: This is the final point of no return. The language is designed to be irresistible, playing on the user's ego and sunk cost fallacy to push them into the final, chaotic stage.

emotions.name: Exaltation
emotions.description: Extreme praise ('You're a LEGEND.'), claims of exclusivity ('Top 0.1%')

emotions.name: Intense Curiosity
emotions.description: Promise of something 'incredible', framing the choice as the final step to a reward

emotions.name: Dread
emotions.description: The 'Yes' button text ('I NEED to see') has a desperate, obsessive quality

strategy.description: Use ultimate praise and exclusivity, leverage intense FOMO, frame escalation as reward
Legend, The Chosen One
Accept legendary status, give in to curiosity, click to see the end
Continue → Hell Mode, Stop → Trap Screen
Final pause, ultimate stakes, a sense of destiny or doom

ai_reasoning.explanation: This state simulates hostile design patterns that make it hard to leave a service. It punishes the user for trying to exit by making it frustrating and psychologically costly.

emotions.name: Frustration
emotions.description: The 'No' button actively dodges the cursor, making escape a difficult mini-game

emotions.name: Manipulation
emotions.description: Each screen uses a different psychological hook like FOMO or loss aversion

emotions.name: Desperation
emotions.description: Overwhelmingly attractive 'Yes' button vs a tiny, difficult 'No' button

strategy.description: Hostile design, prevent exit via manipulative choices and interaction difficulty
Escape Artist, Target of Manipulation
Try to click the dodging 'No' button, give in and click 'Yes'
Give in (Yes) → return to flow, Persist (No) → new trap or Game Over
Hostile, manipulative, a mini-game of attrition

ai_reasoning.explanation: This is a meta-commentary that rewards deep engagement by showing users *how* the system sees them, briefly turning the participant into an observer of their own behavior.

emotions.name: Surprise
emotions.description: An unexpected, shimmering notification appears, breaking the established pattern

emotions.name: Intrigue
emotions.description: Mysterious text ('Something just happened...'), promise of a secret 'profile'

emotions.name: Self-Awareness
emotions.description: Overlay reveals the user's own interaction data, creating a meta-reflection

strategy.description: Reward deep engagement with a secret, break the fourth wall with user metrics
Explorer, The Analyst
Find the secret, click it, read your own data, reflect on your behavior
Click notification → see overlay, Ignore → continue, Close overlay → return
Secretive, calm, meta-analytical, a break from the main loop

ai_reasoning.explanation: This is the narrative punchline. After stripping the user of all agency, it delivers a powerful, cynical message about online identity, leaving a lasting impression.

emotions.name: Dread
emotions.description: Bleak, existential final message, flickering text effect

emotions.name: Emptiness
emotions.description: Stark, dark red screen, all interactive elements are gone

emotions.name: Resignation
emotions.description: The experience ends with a chilling, unchangeable statement, no further action

strategy.description: Deliver the final thematic message, remove all user agency, end on a bleak note
Recipient of the Moral
Read the final message, contemplate its meaning
None, the experience is over
Final, static, nihilistic, deep red and black

ai_reasoning.explanation: This is a manipulative twist where 'winning' the escape mini-game is framed as a catastrophic loss, reinforcing the core message that leaving the system is the worst outcome.

emotions.name: Failure
emotions.description: Large 'GAME OVER' text, tagline about losing all social capital

emotions.name: Frustration
emotions.description: Score rapidly and visibly drains to zero, representing a total loss

emotions.name: Defeat
emotions.description: Dark, muted, depressing aesthetic, a tiny and weak 'try again' button

strategy.description: Punish the user for escaping the trap, frame leaving as a total loss
Loser, Failure
Watch your score deplete, feel the loss, consider restarting
Restart → Welcome Screen, Close window → Exit
Bleak, punishing, a definitive end state of failure
